hypothesis: Growth-agent builders will delegate Instagram sender operations rather than only ask for source code
cheapest_test: Run a concierge campaign for 50-100 vetted creators using one customer-controlled sender
success_rule: Two teams connect a real sender and provide a real list; one commits to a recurring managed fee
failure_rule: Interest stops at a demo or repository request

hypothesis: Relationship-aware personal tone produces visible value beyond reliable delivery
cheapest_test: For the same campaign compare approved profile-aware openers against approved variable-substitution templates
success_rule: Profile-aware messages achieve a materially higher positive-reply rate without higher block/report signals
failure_rule: No meaningful reply-quality difference or approvals take too long

hypothesis: Instagram is a sufficient initial wedge without native LinkedIn
cheapest_test: Offer Instagram execution plus WhatsApp reply handoff while using no new LinkedIn connector
success_rule: A pilot reaches a paid continuation without requesting native LinkedIn as a blocker
failure_rule: Every qualified buyer requires LinkedIn before connecting Instagram

hypothesis: Customers will pay for managed reliability while keeping the data plane open
cheapest_test: Offer open-source local Switchboard plus a priced managed sender/campaign service
success_rule: At least one pilot chooses the managed service at $200-$500 monthly or equivalent
failure_rule: All pilots self-host and decline operational support
